question: Why is material wealth insufficient compared to possessing this kaula teaching?
premises: One might possess an ocean filled with jewels
This is contrasted implicitly with the teaching's value
inference: Even vast material wealth is not comparable to the value of this kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is difficult to parse and may contain a scribal issue.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
